title: P1: WebSocket broadcast race condition in dashboard app
description:
File: python/src/lichen/dashboard/app.py
Line: 129

The _broadcast_ws function iterates over _ws_clients with 'for ws in _ws_clients:' and then awaits ws.send_text(). During that await, another coroutine can execute ws_events() and call '_ws_clients.add(websocket)' at line 344, modifying the set during iteration.

This causes RuntimeError: Set changed size during iteration.

Fix: Copy the set before iterating:
  for ws in list(_ws_clients):
or use a lock.
close_reason: Fixed by copying the set before iteration: for ws in list(_ws_clients):
